review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 24, 10:27 AM ET. It had Blue Hens 37% and Tigers 63%, projecting Blue Hens 2.3 – Tigers 3 (5.3 total, Tigers by 0.7).

Final: Blue Hens 0 – Tigers 2. Right winner: it had Tigers at 63%.

review.body:
Blue Hens came in with a 7% below average attack and a 8% leakier than average defense (no scoring on file: rated at the league average), worth about 24 and 24 games of evidence. Projected to score 2.3, they scored 0 (−2.3 goals, 100% under); projected to allow 3, they allowed 2 (−1 goals, 34% under).

Tigers came in with a 4% below average attack and a 3% stingier than average defense (no scoring on file: rated at the league average), worth about 22 and 22 games of evidence. Projected to score 3, they scored 2 (−1 goals, 34% under); projected to allow 2.3, they allowed 0 (−2.3 goals, 100% under).

The bigger miss was Blue Hens' scoring (-2.3 goals against projection); both sides underscored their projections, so the game ran colder than either team's numbers said.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×0.407 of the raw projection, and the home side beat its projected margin by +1.2 goals. It counts toward Hockey+ scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections (it's how teams with no standings on the routes build a record of their own).

Across 238 graded Hockey+ games the algo now scales scoring ×0.940 and gives home teams -0.1 goals. Team corrections so far: Blue Hens attack ×0.960, defense ×1.040 (6 games); Tigers attack ×0.960, defense ×0.960 (9 games).

review.title: Bottom line
review.body: Right side, total outside its normal range, margin within its normal range, no bet.
